claims.text: Refractory high-entropy alloys can be used as structural materials for high-temperature plasma-facing components in fusion reactors.
Refractory high-entropy alloys are low-activation materials.
Exposure to high-temperature plasma affects the microstructure and composition of refractory high-entropy alloys.
Refractory high-entropy alloys possess irradiation resistance.
Refractory high-entropy alloys possess mechanical properties suitable for high-temperature service.
Irradiation resistance and high-temperature mechanical properties allow refractory high-entropy alloys to maintain structural integrity under fusion-reactor conditions.
Refractory high-entropy alloys exhibit low activation under fusion-reactor conditions.
The applicability of refractory high-entropy alloys is bounded by their temperature and irradiation limits.
Specific data on the behavior of refractory high-entropy alloys in fusion-reactor environments are lacking.
